articles.title: Microsoft 365 Token Replay Attacks Let Hackers Access Business Emails Without Passwords
articles.summary:

Huntress recorded 497 successful sign-ins and more than 200,000 failed attempts during the ten-week campaign, which ran from July 14 through September 22, 2026.
